text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: p95 latency spike on /v1/embeddings for region-us-west-2. Error rate up 8% over baseline. Pager: #oncall. See auto-attach logs: https://logs.internal/redwood/2145129999
Elaine (oncall): acked. looking at logs now — I see KV cache eviction errors and backlog on the inference queue.
Raj: saw same. top traces show heavy overhead on kv-serialization during cold starts, also GPUs at 92% util. likely backpressure.
Mike: are customers affected? any requests with 5xx or just latency?
Elaine (oncall): both. 502s ~2% of traffic in the last 10m, latency p95 jumped from 120ms -> 1.2s. downstream batch timeouts for long prompts.
Sophie: flagging product impact: a few PLG users on beta embeddings might see failures. can CS surface any urgent customers? @CS Bot please check active trials.
CS Bot: Found 4 accounts with spikes > 10% errors in last 15m: acme-inc, paperly, searchly, probe-ai. Contacted success leads via thread DM.
Jordan: quick mitigation options: 1) scale inference replicas in us-west-2 (fast), 2) evict large prefix entries in KV cache for embeddings (risky), 3) fallback route embeddings to quantized-small model until stable.
Elaine (oncall): doing 1) now with redwood cli: ```sh
redwood scale --region us-west-2 --pool embeddings --replicas +3
``` ETA ~2m. rolling restarts might add noise.
Raj: while scaling, recommend applying a temporary KV eviction for entries > 512KB: ```py
# evict keys older than 3h
redis-cli --scan | xargs -n1 -I{} redis-cli ttl {} | grep -n ">="
``` do with care.
Mike: prefer fallback route first to avoid risky cache surgery. can we route a small percent of traffic to quantized-xl variant?
Jordan: yes, can create a routing rule for canary: ```json
{"route":"/v1/embeddings","percent":"15","model":"embedder-quant-xl"}
``` done via console, propagation ~30s.
Elaine (oncall): routed 15% -> quant-xl. monitoring results: error rate down to 5%, p95 -> 600ms. still elevated but improving.
Sophie: good. once stable, we need a post-incident review and concrete remediation. can we pick owners and sizes now?
Raj: I propose remediation backlog items: - KV serialization efficiency (L) - KV eviction policy & safer tooling (M) - autoscale tuning for embeddings pools (S) - routing rollback automation (S)
Mike: add: alerting refinement: differentiate backpressure vs node failures (M) and customer-impact mapping in alerts (S).
Jordan: I'll take autoscale tuning (owner: Jordan) estimate S (1-2 days) to update HPA and test.
Raj: I'll own KV serialization (owner: Raj) estimate L (2-3 sprints) — need benchmarks and maybe C++ refactor.
Elaine (oncall): I'll draft a safer KV eviction CLI and playbook (owner: Elaine) estimate M (1 sprint).
Sophie: Product will own customer comms and postmortem write-up. assign Sophie (owner) estimate S (2 days) to coordinate with CS.
Mike: I'll own alert refinement (owner: Mike) estimate M (3-5 days).
Elaine (oncall): let's create action items and prioritize: Severity: P1 (customer-impacting) -> items: autoscale tuning (high), KV eviction tooling (high), routing rollback automation (medium), alerts (medium), long-term serialization (low but needed). Tie to Q2: autoscale + eviction tooling must land in Q2. serialization tracked Q3.
Sophie: scheduling postmortem: propose tomorrow 10:00am PT. who can attend?
Raj: I can do tomorrow 10.
Jordan: available.
Mike: yep.
Elaine (oncall): I'll join, blocking my morning for handoff notes.
Sophie: ok locking postmortem: 10:00am PT tomorrow — invite sent (calendar: Postincident Review - Embeddings Backpressure).
Jordan: created tickets (placeholders): https://jira.redwood/browse/INF-9801 autoscale tuning, INF-9802 eviction tool, INF-9803 routing-automation, INF-9804 alerts. please add sub-tasks and estimates.
Raj: added acceptance criteria to INF-9801 and INF-9802. INF-9802 acceptance: safe dry-run mode + audit log + bounded throttle.
Mike: marking priorities in sprint board: INF-9801 P0, INF-9802 P0, INF-9804 P1, INF-9803 P1.
Elaine (oncall): follow-ups for immediate postincident cleanup: 1) scale down extra replicas after stabilization (Elaine), 2) run cache health audit (Raj), 3) notify affected customers with timeline (Sophie/CS).
CS Bot: Notified account owners for acme-inc and probe-ai; paperly & searchly queued for follow-up postmortem comms.
Sophie: will draft postmortem template and circulate before meeting. include timeline, customer impact, mitigation steps, root cause hypothesis, and action item table with owners + estimates.
Jordan: plan to add telemetry dashboards for queue depth and kv-serialization latency by model. estimate M.
Elaine (oncall): final status: cluster stabilized, error rate down to 0.8%, p95 ~140ms, scaling down replicas now. will keep watch for 1h then close page. :white_check_mark:
Mike: thanks team. please ensure tickets have clear owners and due dates. we'll review in postmortem.
Sophie: adding this thread to the meeting notes and marking required attendees. thanks all :heart:
incident-bot: Incident update: resolved -> monitoring. Postmortem meeting scheduled. Thread closed for now.
